source.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ בַּבֹּ֜קֶר וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵֽהַשִּׁטִּ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן ה֖וּא וְכָל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּלִ֥נוּ שָׁ֖ם טֶ֥רֶם יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And rose early Joshua in the morning, and they set out from the Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all [the] sons of Israel, and they lodged there before they crossed over.

en.L: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and they set out from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and they lodged there before they crossed over.
en.B: Joshua got up early in the morning. He and all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} set out from Shittim and came to the Jordan, and they stopped there for the night before crossing over.
en.R: Early in the morning, Joshua and all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} left Shittim and went to the Jordan River. They camped there before they crossed the river.

sw.L: Yoshua akaamka mapema asubuhi, nao wakaondoka kutoka Shitimu, wakafika Yordani, yeye na wana wote wa Israeli, wakalala huko kabla hawajavuka.
sw.B: Yoshua aliamka mapema asubuhi. Yeye pamoja na Waisraeli wote waliondoka Shitimu, wakafika Yordani, wakalala huko usiku kabla ya kuvuka.
sw.R: Asubuhi na mapema, Yoshua na Waisraeli wote waliondoka Shitimu, wakaenda hadi Mto Yordani. Wakapiga kambi huko kabla ya kuvuka mto.

es.L: Y Josué se levantó temprano por la mañana, y partieron de Sitim y llegaron al Jordán, él y todos los hijos de Israel, y pasaron allí la noche antes de cruzar.
es.B: Josué se levantó temprano por la mañana. Él y todos los israelitas partieron de Sitim y llegaron al Jordán, y se detuvieron allí a pasar la noche antes de cruzar.
es.R: Temprano por la mañana, Josué y todos los israelitas salieron de Sitim y fueron hasta el río Jordán. Acamparon allí antes de cruzar el río.

decisions.choice: Shittim: Israel's last camp east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: The name means "acacia trees". Israel camped there on the plains of Moab across the river from Jericho (Numbers 25:1; 33:49, where it is called Abel-shittim), and the two spies were sent out from there (2:1).

decisions.choice: rose early in the morning: set out without delay
decisions.reason: The phrase often marks a prompt start to an important task (Genesis 22:3; Exodus 24:4; Joshua 6:12). Joshua acts at once on the report the spies brought back (2:24).

decisions.choice: lodged: stayed overnight
decisions.reason: The verb means to spend the night. Verse 2 says three days passed before the officers gave their orders, so the stay by the river may have lasted more than one night.

decisions.choice: the Jordan River
decisions.reason: Readable adds "River" at the first mention so that a new reader knows what the Jordan is.

source.text: וַיְהִ֕י מִקְצֵ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ הַשֹּׁטְרִ֖ים בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was at [the] end of three days, and passed the officers through [the] midst of the camp.

en.L: And it came about at the end of three days that the officers passed through the midst of the camp.
en.B: At the end of three days the officers went throughout the camp.
en.R: After three days, the officers went all through the camp.

sw.L: Ikawa mwisho wa siku tatu, maafisa wakapita katikati ya kambi.
sw.B: Siku tatu zilipokwisha, maafisa walipita katika kambi yote.
sw.R: Baada ya siku tatu, maafisa walipita kambi nzima.

es.L: Y sucedió al cabo de tres días que los oficiales pasaron por en medio del campamento.
es.B: Al cabo de tres días, los oficiales recorrieron el campamento.
es.R: Después de tres días, los oficiales recorrieron todo el campamento.

decisions.choice: at the end of three days: the time Joshua set in 1:11
decisions.reason: In 1:10-11 Joshua told the officers to tell the people that within three days they would cross the Jordan. This verse takes up that count. The spies also spent three days hiding in the hills (2:22); the chapters do not say exactly how the two sets of days line up.

decisions.choice: officers: officials who passed orders on to the people
decisions.reason: These are the officials Joshua gave orders to in 1:10. The word is used for officials who kept records and saw that orders were carried out among the people (Exodus 5:6; Numbers 11:16; Deuteronomy 20:5).

source.text: וַיְצַוּוּ֮ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹר֒ כִּרְאֽוֹתְכֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאִ֖ים אֹת֑וֹ וְאַתֶּ֗ם תִּסְעוּ֙ מִמְּק֣וֹמְכֶ֔ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אַחֲרָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And they commanded the people, saying, when you see [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh your God, and the priests the Levites carrying it, and you, you will set out from your place and go after it.

en.L: And they commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and the priests, the Levites, carrying it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.
en.B: They gave the people this order: "As soon as you see the Levitical priests carrying the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, move out from where you are and follow it.
en.R: They told the people, "Watch for the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. It is the sacred box that holds the covenant tablets. When you see the priests from the tribe of Levi carrying it, leave your places and follow it.

sw.L: Wakawaamuru watu, wakisema, "Mtakapoliona sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, na makuhani, Walawi, wakilibeba, ndipo mtaondoka mahali penu na kulifuata.
sw.B: Wakawapa watu agizo hili: "Mara mtakapowaona makuhani Walawi wakilibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ondokeni mahali mlipo mlifuate.
sw.R: Wakawaambia watu, "Liangalieni sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Ni sanduku takatifu lenye vibao vya mawe vya agano. Mtakapowaona makuhani wa kabila la Lawi wakilibeba, ondokeni mahali mlipo mlifuate.

es.L: Y mandaron al pueblo, diciendo: «Cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y a los sacerdotes levitas que la llevan, entonces {{plural_you:ustedes partirán|vosotros partiréis}} de {{plural_you:su lugar|vuestro lugar}} e {{plural_you:irán|iréis}} tras ella.
es.B: Dieron al pueblo esta orden: «En cuanto {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} a los sacerdotes levitas llevando el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} en marcha desde donde {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} y {{plural_you:síganla|seguidla}}.
es.R: Les dijeron a los del pueblo: «{{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} atentos al arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. Es el cofre sagrado que guarda las tablas del pacto. Cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} que los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví la llevan, {{plural_you:dejen sus lugares|dejad vuestros lugares}} y {{plural_you:síganla|seguidla}}.

decisions.choice: the ark of the covenant: the chest that held the covenant tablets and marked God's presence
decisions.reason: The ark was a wooden chest covered with gold that held the two stone tablets of the covenant (Exodus 25:10-22; Deuteronomy 10:1-5). It went ahead of Israel on the march (Numbers 10:33-36). In this chapter it leads the way into the Jordan, and the people follow it.

decisions.choice: the priests, the Levites: priests who belong to the tribe of Levi
decisions.reason: The phrase is common in Deuteronomy (17:9; 18:1). It names the priests by their tribe. Deuteronomy 31:9 speaks of "the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of Yahweh".

decisions.choice: and you, you shall set out: the people move only when the ark moves
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is stressed. The ark goes first, and only then is it the people's turn to move.

decisions.choice: It is the sacred box that holds the covenant tablets.
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word "ark" and explains it once, the first time it appears in this chapter.

decisions.choice: being carried by the Levitical priests
decisions.reason: Balanced joins the two things the people will see, the ark and the priests carrying it, into one picture, naming the priests first.

decisions.choice: "sanduku la agano la BWANA"; Readable explains it once as "sanduku takatifu lenye vibao vya mawe vya agano"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua, as in the Pentateuch: the ark is "sanduku", a chest, and "safina" is kept for Noah's boat. Readable adds once what the chest held, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "el arca del pacto"; Readable explains it once as "el cofre sagrado que guarda las tablas del pacto"
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "el arca del pacto" at every level, as in the Pentateuch. Readable keeps the word "arca" and, like the English, explains it the first time it appears in the chapter.

source.text: אַ֣ךְ׀רָח֣וֹק יִהְיֶ֗ה בֵּֽינֵיכֶם֙ וּבֵינָ֔יו כְּאַלְפַּ֥יִם אַמָּ֖ה בַּמִּדָּ֑ה אַֽל־תִּקְרְב֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו לְמַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־תֵּֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־הַדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֧א עֲבַרְתֶּ֛ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Only a distance there will be between you and between it, about two thousand cubits by measure; do not draw near to it, so that you may know the way which you will go in it, for not you have passed on the way yesterday [and] three days ago.

en.L: Only there shall be a distance between you and it, about 2,000 cubits by measure; do not come near it, so that you may know the way by which you shall go, for you have not passed on [this] way yesterday [or the day] before."
en.B: But keep a distance of about {{units:3,000 feet|2,000 cubits}} between yourselves and the ark; do not go near it. Then you will know which way to go, since you have never traveled this way before."
en.R: But stay about {{units:3,000 feet|2,000 cubits}} behind it. Do not go near it. Then you will be able to see which way to go. You have never been on this road before."

sw.L: Ila kuwe na umbali kati yenu na hilo, kama dhiraa elfu mbili kwa kipimo; msilikaribie, ili mjue njia mtakayoipita, kwa maana hamjapita katika njia [hii] jana wala juzi."
sw.B: Lakini acheni nafasi ya {{units:kama mita 900|kama dhiraa 2,000}} kati yenu na sanduku hilo; msilikaribie. Ndipo mtakapojua njia ya kupita, kwa sababu hamjawahi kupita njia hii kabla."
sw.R: Lakini kaeni nyuma yake umbali wa {{units:kama mita 900|kama dhiraa 2,000}}. Msilikaribie. Ndipo mtakapoweza kuona njia ya kufuata. Hamjawahi kupita njia hii kabla."

es.L: Solo que habrá una distancia entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y ella, de unos 2 000 codos según medida; no {{plural_you:se acerquen|os acerquéis}} a ella, para que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} el camino por donde {{plural_you:han|habéis}} de ir, porque no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} pasado por [este] camino ni ayer ni anteayer».
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:mantengan|mantened}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y el arca una distancia de {{units:unos 900 metros|2 000 codos}}; no {{plural_you:se acerquen|os acerquéis}} a ella. Así {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} por dónde ir, ya que nunca antes {{plural_you:han|habéis}} pasado por este camino».
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} a unos {{units:900 metros|2 000 codos}} detrás de ella. No {{plural_you:se acerquen|os acerquéis}} a ella. Así {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} ver por dónde ir. Nunca antes {{plural_you:han|habéis}} estado en este camino».

decisions.choice: keep a distance: the ark is holy and not to be approached carelessly
decisions.reason: Only those appointed could come near the ark (Numbers 4:15, 20; 2 Samuel 6:6-7). The distance also let the whole people see the ark ahead of them and follow where it led.

decisions.choice: yesterday and the day before: at any time before now
decisions.reason: The pair of words is a common way of saying "previously" (Genesis 31:2; Exodus 5:7). The people have never traveled this road.

decisions.choice: between it, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the reading the scribes marked (qere) are two spellings of "and between it". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: about 3,000 feet
decisions.reason: A cubit is about 18 inches, so 2,000 cubits is about 3,000 feet, a little over half a mile. The Measures setting shows the original unit; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: kama mita 900 (the units setting: kama dhiraa 2,000)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua, as in the Pentateuch: Swahili measures default to metric, with the original unit as the reader setting, and a cubit is reckoned at 45 cm. This differs from the English, which gives US feet.

source.text: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־הָעָ֖ם הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֖ם נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua to the people, consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow will do Yahweh in your midst wonders.

en.L: And Joshua said to the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will do wonders in your midst."
en.B: Joshua told the people, "Set yourselves apart as holy, because tomorrow {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is going to work wonders among you."
en.R: Joshua told the people, "Make yourselves clean and holy. Tomorrow {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will do amazing things among you."

sw.L: Yoshua akawaambia watu, "Jitakaseni, kwa maana kesho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafanya maajabu katikati yenu."
sw.B: Yoshua aliwaambia watu, "Jiwekeni wakfu, kwa sababu kesho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafanya maajabu miongoni mwenu."
sw.R: Yoshua aliwaambia watu, "Jitakaseni, mwe safi na watakatifu. Kesho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafanya mambo ya ajabu kati yenu."

es.L: Y Josué dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Conságrense|Consagraos}}, porque mañana {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará maravillas en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».
es.B: Josué le dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Apártense|Apartaos}} como pueblo santo, porque mañana {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a hacer maravillas entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».
es.R: Josué le dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Purifíquense|Purificaos}} y {{plural_you:prepárense|preparaos}} para estar delante de Dios. Mañana {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará cosas asombrosas entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».

decisions.choice: consecrate yourselves: get ready for God to act by becoming ritually clean
decisions.reason: Before God appeared at Sinai, the people washed their clothes and kept apart from sexual relations (Exodus 19:10-15). The people here probably prepared in a similar way, because God was about to act among them.

decisions.choice: wonders: deeds beyond human power that only God can do
decisions.reason: The word is used of the plagues on Egypt (Exodus 3:20) and of God's promise when he renewed the covenant (Exodus 34:10). Here it points to the stopping of the Jordan.

decisions.choice: set yourselves apart as holy / make yourselves clean and holy
decisions.reason: The verb means to make oneself holy. Balanced and Readable spell out that sense; Literal keeps "consecrate".

decisions.choice: "purifíquense y prepárense para estar delante de Dios"
decisions.reason: The verb means to make oneself holy, ready for God to act (m1). Spanish has no plain everyday word for "make yourselves holy", so Readable says what the people did: make themselves clean and get ready to stand before God.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר שְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וְעִבְר֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua to the priests, saying, lift up [the] ark of the covenant and pass on before the people. And they lifted up [the] ark of the covenant and went before the people.

en.L: And Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, "Lift up the ark of the covenant and pass over before the people." And they lifted up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.
en.B: Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and go across ahead of the people." So they took up the ark of the covenant and went on ahead of the people.
en.R: Joshua told the priests, "Pick up the ark of the covenant and go across ahead of the people." So the priests picked up the ark and walked in front of the people.

sw.L: Yoshua akawaambia makuhani, akisema, "Liinueni sanduku la agano mvuke mbele ya watu." Wakaliinua sanduku la agano, wakaenda mbele ya watu.
sw.B: Yoshua aliwaambia makuhani, "Libebeni sanduku la agano mvuke mkiwatangulia watu." Basi wakalibeba sanduku la agano, wakawatangulia watu.
sw.R: Yoshua aliwaambia makuhani, "Libebeni sanduku la agano mvuke mto mkiwatangulia watu." Basi makuhani walilibeba sanduku, wakatembea mbele ya watu.

es.L: Y Josué habló a los sacerdotes, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} el arca del pacto y {{plural_you:pasen|pasad}} delante del pueblo». Y alzaron el arca del pacto y fueron delante del pueblo.
es.B: Josué dijo a los sacerdotes: «{{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} el arca del pacto y {{plural_you:crucen|cruzad}} delante del pueblo». Así que tomaron el arca del pacto y avanzaron delante del pueblo.
es.R: Josué les dijo a los sacerdotes: «{{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}} el arca del pacto y {{plural_you:crucen|cruzad}} delante del pueblo». Entonces los sacerdotes levantaron el arca y caminaron delante del pueblo.

decisions.choice: pass over: the key verb of the crossing
decisions.reason: The verb "pass over" or "cross" runs through chapters 1-4 (1:2, 11; 3:1, 14, 16, 17; 4:1). Here the priests are to go on ahead and lead the crossing.

decisions.choice: and they lifted up ... and went: the outcome told first
decisions.reason: The verse sums up what the priests did. The full account of their going into the river follows in verses 14-17, after God's words to Joshua. Biblical stories often give the outcome first and then fill in the details.

decisions.choice: the priests
decisions.reason: Readable names the priests as the ones who lifted the ark, and leaves out the repeated "of the covenant".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ גַּדֶּלְךָ֔ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֛יתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Joshua, the day this I will begin to make you great in [the] eyes of all Israel, that they may know that just as I was with Moses, I will be with you.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Joshua, "This day I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all Israel, that they may know that just as I was with Moses, I will be with you.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to raise you up in the sight of all Israel, so that they will know I will be with you as I was with Moses.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to make you a great leader in the eyes of all the people of Israel. Then they will know that I will be with you, just as I was with Moses.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Yoshua, "Siku hii ya leo nitaanza kukutukuza machoni pa Israeli wote, ili wajue kwamba kama nilivyokuwa pamoja na Musa, nitakuwa pamoja nawe.
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Yoshua, "Leo nitaanza kukuinua machoni pa Israeli wote, ili wajue kwamba nitakuwa pamoja nawe kama nilivyokuwa pamoja na Musa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Yoshua, "Leo nitaanza kukufanya kiongozi mkuu machoni pa watu wote wa Israeli. Ndipo watakapojua kwamba nitakuwa pamoja nawe, kama nilivyokuwa pamoja na Musa.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Josué: «Este día comenzaré a engrandecerte a los ojos de todo Israel, para que sepan que, como estuve con Moisés, estaré contigo.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Josué: «Hoy comenzaré a enaltecerte a la vista de todo Israel, para que sepan que estaré contigo como estuve con Moisés.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Josué: «Hoy comenzaré a hacer de ti un gran líder a los ojos de todo el pueblo de Israel. Así sabrán que estaré contigo, igual que estuve con Moisés.

decisions.choice: make you great: give you standing and honor as leader
decisions.reason: The verb means to make great. God will show the people that Joshua is their leader, as he showed it for Moses at the sea (Exodus 14:31). Joshua 4:14 says it came true: the people held Joshua in awe as they had held Moses.

decisions.choice: as I was with Moses, I will be with you: the promise of 1:5
decisions.reason: God made this promise to Joshua in 1:5, and the people repeated it in 1:17. The crossing of the Jordan is the first proof of it, matching the crossing of the sea under Moses.

decisions.choice: a great leader
decisions.reason: Readable says in what way Joshua will be made great: as the leader of the people.

source.text: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרֽוֹן־הַבְּרִ֖ית לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּבֹאֲכֶ֗ם עַד־קְצֵה֙ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בַּיַּרְדֵּ֖ן תַּעֲמֹֽדוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you, you will command the priests carrying [the] ark of the covenant, saying, when you come to [the] edge of [the] waters of the Jordan, in the Jordan you will stand.

en.L: And you, command the priests who carry the ark of the covenant, saying, 'When you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.'"
en.B: Now you are to give an order to the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: 'Once you have reached the edge of the Jordan's waters, stop and stand in the river.'"
en.R: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant, 'When you come to the edge of the water of the Jordan, step into the river and stand there.'"

sw.L: Nawe uwaamuru makuhani wanaolibeba sanduku la agano, ukisema, 'Mtakapofika ukingoni mwa maji ya Yordani, simameni ndani ya Yordani.'"
sw.B: Sasa wewe uwape agizo makuhani wanaolibeba sanduku la agano: 'Mkishafika ukingoni mwa maji ya Yordani, simameni mtoni.'"
sw.R: Waambie makuhani wanaolibeba sanduku la agano, 'Mtakapofika ukingoni mwa maji ya Yordani, ingieni mtoni msimame humo.'"

es.L: Y tú, manda a los sacerdotes que llevan el arca del pacto, diciendo: “Cuando {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a la orilla de las aguas del Jordán, {{plural_you:se detendrán|os detendréis}} en el Jordán”».
es.B: Ahora tú darás una orden a los sacerdotes que llevan el arca del pacto: “En cuanto {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a la orilla de las aguas del Jordán, {{plural_you:deténganse|deteneos}} y {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} de pie en el río”».
es.R: Diles a los sacerdotes que llevan el arca del pacto: “Cuando {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a la orilla del agua del Jordán, {{plural_you:entren|entrad}} en el río y {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} allí”».

decisions.choice: stand: stop and stay where you are
decisions.reason: The verb means to stand or stand still. The priests are to stop once their feet are in the edge of the water (verse 15) and stay there; in verse 17 they stand firm in the middle of the riverbed.

decisions.choice: and you: God turns from what he will do to what Joshua must do
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed. God has said what he will do for Joshua (verse 7); now he tells Joshua his part.

decisions.choice: step into the river and stand there
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the priests are to go into the water, as verse 15 shows they did, and then stay where they are.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְשִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua to [the] sons of Israel, come near here and hear [the] words of Yahweh your God.

en.L: And Joshua said to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, "Come near here and hear the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."
en.B: Joshua said to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, "Come over here and listen to the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."
en.R: Joshua said to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, "Come here and listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God says."

sw.L: Yoshua akawaambia wana wa Israeli, "Njooni karibu hapa msikie maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."
sw.B: Yoshua aliwaambia Waisraeli, "Njooni hapa msikilize maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."
sw.R: Yoshua aliwaambia Waisraeli, "Njooni hapa msikilize anachosema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."

es.L: Y Josué dijo a los hijos de Israel: «{{plural_you:Acérquense|Acercaos}} aquí y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.B: Josué dijo a los israelitas: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} acá y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.R: Josué les dijo a los israelitas: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} aquí y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».

decisions.choice: the words of Yahweh your God: Joshua passes on God's message
decisions.reason: What Joshua says next (verses 10-13) is presented as God's own word, as the words of Moses were. Joshua speaks for God as Moses had done.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֛י אֵ֥ל חַ֖י בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵ֣שׁ יוֹרִ֣ישׁ מִ֠פְּנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י וְאֶת־הַחִתִּ֜י וְאֶת־הַחִוִּ֗י וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְאֶת־הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua, by this you will know that [the] living God [is] in your midst, and driving out he will drive out from before you the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Perizzite and the Girgashite and the Amorite and the Jebusite.

en.L: And Joshua said, "By this you shall know that the living God [is] in your midst, and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will surely dispossess from before you the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Hivites and the Perizzites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Jebusites.
en.B: Joshua went on, "Here is the way you will know that the living God is in your midst, and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will without fail drive out ahead of you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
en.R: Then Joshua said, "This is how you will be sure that the living God is here among you. You will know that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will surely drive out the peoples who live in this land: the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.

sw.L: Yoshua akasema, "Kwa hili mtajua kwamba Mungu aliye hai [yuko] katikati yenu, na kwamba hakika atawafukuza mbele yenu Wakanaani na Wahiti na Wahivi na Waperizi na Wagirgashi na Waamori na Wayebusi.
sw.B: Yoshua aliendelea, "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyojua kwamba Mungu aliye hai yuko kati yenu, na kwamba hakika atawafukuza mbele yenu Wakanaani, Wahiti, Wahivi, Waperizi, Wagirgashi, Waamori na Wayebusi.
sw.R: Kisha Yoshua akasema, "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyojua kwa hakika kwamba Mungu aliye hai yuko hapa kati yenu. Mtajua kwamba hakika atawafukuza watu wanaoishi katika nchi hii: Wakanaani, Wahiti, Wahivi, Waperizi, Wagirgashi, Waamori na Wayebusi.

es.L: Y dijo Josué: «En esto {{plural_you:conocerán|conoceréis}} que el Dios vivo [está] en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ciertamente desalojará de delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al cananeo y al hitita y al heveo y al ferezeo y al gergeseo y al amorreo y al jebuseo.
es.B: Josué siguió diciendo: «Así es como {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que el Dios vivo está en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y que sin falta {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} expulsará delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a los cananeos, hititas, heveos, ferezeos, gergeseos, amorreos y jebuseos.
es.R: Luego Josué dijo: «Así es como {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} seguros de que el Dios vivo está aquí entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} de veras expulsará a los pueblos que viven en esta tierra: los cananeos, hititas, heveos, ferezeos, gergeseos, amorreos y jebuseos.

decisions.choice: the living God: the God who acts, unlike lifeless idols
decisions.reason: The title sets Israel's God against gods that cannot act (Deuteronomy 5:26; 1 Samuel 17:26; Psalm 115:3-8). The stopping of the Jordan will show that he is present and at work among his people.

decisions.choice: will surely dispossess: a doubled verb that makes the promise certain
decisions.reason: The verb is repeated in two forms, a way of stressing that something will certainly happen. The verb means to dispossess, to drive out those who held the land so that others take it over.

decisions.choice: the seven peoples of Canaan
decisions.reason: The same seven peoples are listed in Deuteronomy 7:1. They lived in the land when Israel arrived; the Canaanites were by the sea and the Amorites in the hill country and beyond (5:1; Numbers 13:29). Each name is singular and stands for the whole people.

decisions.choice: the peoples who live in this land
decisions.reason: Readable says who the seven names are before listing them.

decisions.choice: the peoples in the singular at Literal: "al cananeo y al hitita ..."
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names each people in the singular, as a whole people. Spanish can keep this form ("el cananeo"), so Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the plural names, as the English does at every level.

source.text: הִנֵּה֙ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲד֖וֹן כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ עֹבֵ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם בַּיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, [the] ark of the covenant of [the] Lord of all the earth [is] passing on before you into the Jordan.

en.L: Look, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is passing over before you into the Jordan.
en.B: See, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is going ahead of you into the Jordan.
en.R: Look! The ark of the covenant of the Lord of the whole earth is going into the Jordan ahead of you.

sw.L: Tazama, sanduku la agano la Bwana wa dunia yote linavuka mbele yenu kuingia Yordani.
sw.B: Angalieni, sanduku la agano la Bwana wa dunia yote linawatangulia kuingia Yordani.
sw.R: Tazameni! Sanduku la agano la Bwana wa dunia yote linaingia katika Yordani likiwatangulia.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, el arca del pacto del Señor de toda la tierra pasa delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al Jordán.
es.B: {{plural_you:Fíjense|Fijaos}}: el arca del pacto del Señor de toda la tierra va delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al Jordán.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! El arca del pacto del Señor de toda la tierra va a entrar en el Jordán delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

decisions.choice: the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth
decisions.reason: The text reads "the ark of the covenant, Lord of all the earth": "covenant" carries the article, and the title follows it. The title is best taken as naming the owner of the ark, as verse 13 says plainly: "the ark of Yahweh, Lord of all the earth".

decisions.choice: the Lord of all the earth: God rules every land, Canaan included
decisions.reason: The title (also verse 13; Micah 4:13; Psalm 97:5) says that Israel's God is master of the whole earth, not the god of one place. He is leading his people into a land he already rules.

decisions.choice: is passing over: about to take place
decisions.reason: The participle describes what is about to happen as if it were already under way.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ שְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר אִ֔ישׁ מִשִּׁבְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃

records.literal_gloss: And now take for yourselves two [and] ten men from [the] tribes of Israel, a man one, a man one for the tribe.

en.L: And now take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man, one man for each tribe.
en.B: Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man from each tribe.
en.R: Now choose twelve men, one from each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

sw.L: Basi sasa jitwalieni watu kumi na wawili kutoka katika makabila ya Israeli, mtu mmoja, mtu mmoja kwa kila kabila.
sw.B: Sasa chagueni watu kumi na wawili kutoka katika makabila ya Israeli, mtu mmoja kutoka kila kabila.
sw.R: Sasa chagueni watu kumi na wawili, mmoja kutoka kila moja ya makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.

es.L: Y ahora {{plural_you:tomen|tomad}} para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} doce hombres de las tribus de Israel, un hombre, un hombre por cada tribu.
es.B: Ahora {{plural_you:escojan|escoged}} doce hombres de las tribus de Israel, un hombre de cada tribu.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:escojan|escoged}} doce hombres, uno de cada una de las doce tribus de Israel.

decisions.choice: take twelve men: their task is told only in chapter 4
decisions.reason: Joshua does not yet say why the men are chosen. In 4:2-7 they carry twelve stones from the riverbed to be a memorial of the crossing.

decisions.choice: one man, one man: one for each
decisions.reason: Repeating the phrase gives the sense "one each": one man from every tribe (Numbers 13:2).

decisions.choice: choose
decisions.reason: The verb is "take"; here it means to select men for a task.

source.text: וְהָיָ֡ה כְּנ֣וֹחַ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאֵי֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה אֲד֤וֹן כָּל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ בְּמֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יִכָּ֣רֵת֔וּן הַמַּ֥יִם הַיֹּרְדִ֖ים מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְיַעַמְד֖וּ נֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, when rest [the] soles of [the] feet of the priests carrying [the] ark of Yahweh, Lord of all the earth, in [the] waters of the Jordan, [the] waters of the Jordan will be cut off, the waters coming down from above, and they will stand [as] a heap one.

en.L: And it shall be, when the soles of the feet of the priests who carry the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off, the waters coming down from above, and they will stand [in] one heap."
en.B: The priests carrying the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Lord of all the earth, will set the soles of their feet in the Jordan's waters, and as soon as they do, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The water flowing down from upstream will stand up in a single heap."
en.R: The priests will carry the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Lord of the whole earth. As soon as their feet touch the water of the Jordan, the river will stop flowing. The water coming down the river will be held back, and it will pile up in one heap."

sw.L: Na itakuwa nyayo za miguu ya makuhani wanaolibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wa dunia yote, zitakapotulia katika maji ya Yordani, maji ya Yordani yatakatika, yale maji yanayoshuka kutoka juu, nayo yatasimama chungu moja."
sw.B: Makuhani wanaolibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wa dunia yote, wataweka nyayo za miguu yao katika maji ya Yordani, na mara watakapofanya hivyo, maji ya Yordani yatakatika. Maji yanayotiririka kutoka juu yatasimama kama chungu moja."
sw.R: Makuhani watalibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wa dunia yote. Mara miguu yao itakapogusa maji ya Yordani, mto utaacha kutiririka. Maji yanayoshuka mtoni yatazuiliwa, nayo yatajikusanya mahali pamoja kama chungu."

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando las plantas de los pies de los sacerdotes que llevan el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Señor de toda la tierra, se posen en las aguas del Jordán, las aguas del Jordán quedarán cortadas, las aguas que bajan de arriba, y se detendrán [en] un solo montón».
es.B: Los sacerdotes que llevan el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Señor de toda la tierra, pondrán las plantas de los pies en las aguas del Jordán, y en cuanto lo hagan, las aguas del Jordán quedarán cortadas. El agua que baja de río arriba se levantará en un solo montón».
es.R: Los sacerdotes llevarán el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Señor de toda la tierra. En cuanto sus pies toquen el agua del Jordán, el río dejará de correr. El agua que baja por el río quedará detenida y se amontonará en un solo lugar».

decisions.choice: stand in one heap: the waters as at the sea
decisions.reason: The word "heap" describes the waters of the sea in Israel's song (Exodus 15:8) and in Psalm 78:13. The crossing of the Jordan repeats the crossing of the sea (4:23).

decisions.choice: be cut off: stop flowing
decisions.reason: The verb means to be cut. The flow from upstream is cut off, so the water below runs away and the riverbed is left dry (verse 16).

decisions.choice: the soles of the feet rest: the moment the priests step into the water
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures the first touch of the priests' feet on the water, as verse 15 tells it.

decisions.choice: the priests' task first, then the promise
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long sentence into short ones, starting with the priests carrying the ark.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י בִּנְסֹ֤עַ הָעָם֙ מֵאָ֣הֳלֵיהֶ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים נֹֽשְׂאֵ֛י הָאָר֥וֹן הַבְּרִ֖ית לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when set out the people from their tents to cross the Jordan, and the priests carrying the ark of the covenant [were] before the people,

en.L: And it came about, when the people set out from their tents to cross over the Jordan, with the priests who carried the ark of the covenant before the people,
en.B: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, with the priests carrying the ark of the covenant ahead of them,
en.R: The people left their tents to cross the Jordan. The priests carrying the ark of the covenant went ahead of them.

sw.L: Ikawa watu walipoondoka kutoka mahema yao ili kuvuka Yordani, na makuhani wanaolibeba sanduku la agano [wakiwa] mbele ya watu,
sw.B: Basi watu walipovunja kambi ili kuvuka Yordani, makuhani wakiwa wamelibeba sanduku la agano mbele yao,
sw.R: Watu waliondoka kwenye mahema yao ili kuvuka Yordani. Makuhani waliolibeba sanduku la agano waliwatangulia.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando el pueblo partió de sus tiendas para cruzar el Jordán, con los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca del pacto delante del pueblo,
es.B: Así, cuando el pueblo levantó el campamento para cruzar el Jordán, con los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca del pacto delante de ellos,
es.R: El pueblo salió de sus tiendas para cruzar el Jordán. Los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca del pacto iban delante de ellos.

decisions.choice: one sentence running through verses 14-16
decisions.reason: Verses 14 and 15 set the scene with a chain of "when" clauses; the main statement comes in verse 16: the waters stood still.

decisions.choice: set out from their tents: broke camp
decisions.reason: The verb means to pull up the tent pegs and move on. The people left the camp where they had stayed by the river (verses 1-2).

source.text: וּכְב֞וֹא נֹשְׂאֵ֤י הָֽאָרוֹן֙ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְרַגְלֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָֽאָר֔וֹן נִטְבְּל֖וּ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַמָּ֑יִם וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מָלֵא֙ עַל־כָּל־גְּדוֹתָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י קָצִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: and when came those carrying the ark to the Jordan, and [the] feet of the priests carrying the ark were dipped in [the] edge of the waters, and the Jordan is full over all its banks all [the] days of harvest,

en.L: and when those who carried the ark came to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who carried the ark were dipped in the edge of the water (now the Jordan overflows all its banks all the days of harvest),
en.B: and as soon as the men carrying the ark reached the Jordan and the priests' feet dipped into the edge of the water (the Jordan overflows all its banks throughout the harvest season),
en.R: It was harvest time, when the Jordan floods over all its banks. The priests carrying the ark came to the river, and as soon as their feet touched the edge of the water,

sw.L: na wale waliolibeba sanduku walipofika Yordani, na miguu ya makuhani waliolibeba sanduku ikachovywa ukingoni mwa maji (na Yordani hufurika juu ya kingo zake zote siku zote za mavuno),
sw.B: na mara wale waliolibeba sanduku walipofika Yordani, miguu ya makuhani ikagusa ukingo wa maji (Yordani hufurika kingo zake zote wakati wote wa mavuno),
sw.R: Ulikuwa wakati wa mavuno, wakati Mto Yordani hufurika kingo zake zote. Makuhani waliolibeba sanduku walifika mtoni, na mara miguu yao ilipogusa ukingo wa maji,

es.L: y cuando los que llevaban el arca llegaron al Jordán, y los pies de los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca se mojaron en la orilla del agua (pues el Jordán se desborda por todas sus riberas todos los días de la cosecha),
es.B: y en cuanto los que llevaban el arca llegaron al Jordán y los pies de los sacerdotes se mojaron en la orilla del agua (el Jordán se desborda por todas sus riberas durante toda la temporada de la cosecha),
es.R: Era el tiempo de la cosecha, cuando el Jordán se desborda por todas sus orillas. Los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca llegaron al río, y en cuanto sus pies tocaron la orilla del agua,

decisions.choice: the days of harvest: spring, when the Jordan is in flood
decisions.reason: The crossing took place in the first month, in spring (4:19), at the time of the barley harvest. Rain and melting snow from the northern mountains then fill the Jordan, and it spreads over its banks (1 Chronicles 12:16). The river was at its hardest to cross.

decisions.choice: the Jordan overflows ...: a note from the narrator
decisions.reason: The clause breaks into the story to tell the reader why the event was so remarkable.

decisions.choice: were dipped: the priests' feet just entered the water
decisions.reason: The verb means to be dipped or plunged. The priests had only stepped into the edge of the water when the river stopped.

decisions.choice: the note about the harvest first
decisions.reason: Readable gives the narrator's note as its own sentence before the moment the priests step in, so the story can run straight on into verse 16.

decisions.choice: the men carrying the ark
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "those carrying the ark"; the same verse names them as the priests.

source.text: וַיַּעַמְד֡וּ הַמַּיִם֩ הַיֹּרְדִ֨ים מִלְמַ֜עְלָה קָ֣מוּ נֵד־אֶחָ֗ד הַרְחֵ֨ק מְאֹ֜ד מֵֽאָדָ֤ם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִצַּ֣ד צָֽרְתָ֔ן וְהַיֹּרְדִ֗ים עַ֣ל יָ֧ם הָעֲרָבָ֛ה יָם־הַמֶּ֖לַח תַּ֣מּוּ נִכְרָ֑תוּ וְהָעָ֥ם עָבְר֖וּ נֶ֥גֶד יְרִיחֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and stood the waters coming down from above; they rose up [as] a heap one very far away, at Adam, the city which [is] beside Zarethan; and those going down to [the] sea of the Arabah, [the] sea of the salt, were completely cut off; and the people crossed over opposite Jericho.

en.L: the waters coming down from above stood still; they rose up in one heap very far away, at Adam, the city that [is] beside Zarethan; and those going down toward the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off; and the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
en.B: the water flowing down from upstream stopped. It rose up in a single heap a great distance away, at Adam, the town next to Zarethan, while the water running down to the Sea of the Arabah, the Dead Sea, was cut off completely. And the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
en.R: the water coming down the river stopped flowing. It piled up in one heap far up the river, at a town called Adam, near Zarethan. The water flowing down to the Dead Sea was completely cut off. So the people crossed the river near Jericho.

sw.L: maji yaliyoshuka kutoka juu yakasimama; yakainuka chungu moja mbali sana, huko Adamu, mji ulio kando ya Sarethani; na yale yaliyoshuka kuelekea bahari ya Araba, Bahari ya Chumvi, yakakatika kabisa; na watu wakavuka mkabala na Yeriko.
sw.B: maji yaliyotiririka kutoka juu yalisimama. Yakainuka kama chungu moja mbali sana, huko Adamu, mji ulio karibu na Sarethani, na maji yaliyotiririka kwenda Bahari ya Araba, yaani Bahari ya Chumvi, yakakatika kabisa. Nao watu wakavuka mkabala na Yeriko.
sw.R: maji yaliyoshuka mtoni yaliacha kutiririka. Yalijikusanya kama chungu mbali juu ya mto, kwenye mji uitwao Adamu, karibu na Sarethani. Maji yaliyokuwa yakitiririka kwenda Bahari Mfu yalikatika kabisa. Basi watu wakavuka mto karibu na Yeriko.

es.L: las aguas que bajaban de arriba se detuvieron; se levantaron en un solo montón muy lejos, en Adam, la ciudad que [está] junto a Saretán; y las que bajaban hacia el mar del Arabá, el mar Salado, quedaron cortadas por completo; y el pueblo cruzó frente a Jericó.
es.B: el agua que bajaba de río arriba se detuvo. Se levantó en un solo montón a gran distancia, en Adam, la ciudad que está junto a Saretán, mientras que el agua que corría hacia el mar del Arabá, el mar Muerto, quedó cortada por completo. Y el pueblo cruzó frente a Jericó.
es.R: el agua que bajaba por el río dejó de correr. Se amontonó en un solo lugar, muy lejos río arriba, en una ciudad llamada Adam, cerca de Saretán. El agua que corría hacia el mar Muerto quedó cortada por completo. Así el pueblo cruzó el río cerca de Jericó.

decisions.choice: at Adam
alternatives: the waters rose up in a heap reaching from Adam
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "at Adam"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "from Adam". With "very far away" before it, "from Adam" most likely means the same thing: the heap stood far off, at that town. It could also mean that the piled-up water reached all the way from Adam.

decisions.choice: Adam and Zarethan: towns in the Jordan valley north of the crossing
decisions.reason: Adam is probably the site where the Jabbok River joins the Jordan, some 20 miles upstream from the crossing near Jericho. Zarethan lay near it (1 Kings 7:46). Because the flow was stopped so far upstream, a long stretch of riverbed was left dry.

decisions.choice: the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea: the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: The Arabah is the deep valley through which the Jordan runs. The sea at its southern end was called the Salt Sea for its very salty water (Genesis 14:3; Deuteronomy 3:17).

decisions.choice: the Dead Sea (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the name by which the sea is known today, as in Numbers 34:3 and Joshua 15:2; Readable leaves out the older name "Sea of the Arabah".

decisions.choice: a town called Adam
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Adam is the name of a town.

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Chumvi" (L, B); "Bahari Mfu" (R)
alternatives: "Bahari Mfu" at Balanced too, as the English "the Dead Sea"
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 3:17: Balanced keeps the Bible's own name, "Bahari ya Chumvi", which Swahili readers know; Readable uses "Bahari Mfu", the name on maps.

source.text: וַיַּעַמְד֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹ֠שְׂאֵי הָאָר֨וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֜ה בֶּחָֽרָבָ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הָכֵ֑ן וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹֽבְרִים֙ בֶּחָ֣רָבָ֔ה עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֨מּוּ֙ כָּל־הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And stood the priests carrying the ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh on dry ground in [the] middle of the Jordan firmly, and all Israel [were] crossing on dry ground, until that had finished all the nation crossing the Jordan.

en.L: And the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel was crossing over on dry ground, until the whole nation had finished crossing over the Jordan.
en.B: The priests who bore the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} took a firm stand on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan. Meanwhile all Israel went across on dry ground, until the entire nation had completed the crossing.
en.R: Holding the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the priests stood still on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan. They stayed there while all the people of Israel walked across on dry ground, until the whole nation had crossed the river.

sw.L: Makuhani waliolibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakasimama imara juu ya nchi kavu katikati ya Yordani, na Israeli wote wakavuka juu ya nchi kavu, mpaka taifa lote lilipomaliza kuvuka Yordani.
sw.B: Makuhani waliolibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walisimama imara juu ya nchi kavu katikati ya Yordani. Wakati huo Israeli wote walivuka juu ya nchi kavu, mpaka taifa lote lilipomaliza kuvuka.
sw.R: Makuhani walilishika sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakasimama bila kutikisika juu ya nchi kavu katikati ya Yordani. Walikaa hapo wakati watu wote wa Israeli walipovuka juu ya nchi kavu, mpaka taifa lote lilipomaliza kuvuka mto.

es.L: Y los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estuvieron firmes sobre tierra seca en medio del Jordán, mientras todo Israel cruzaba sobre tierra seca, hasta que toda la nación terminó de cruzar el Jordán.
es.B: Los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se mantuvieron firmes sobre tierra seca en medio del Jordán. Mientras tanto, todo Israel fue cruzando sobre tierra seca, hasta que toda la nación terminó de cruzar.
es.R: Con el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en sus manos, los sacerdotes se quedaron quietos sobre tierra seca en medio del Jordán. Se quedaron allí mientras todo el pueblo de Israel cruzaba a pie sobre tierra seca, hasta que toda la nación terminó de cruzar el río.

decisions.choice: dry ground: the word used at the sea
decisions.reason: The same word describes the seabed laid bare at the crossing of the sea (Exodus 14:21). The two crossings mirror each other (4:23).

decisions.choice: firmly: steady, fixed in place
decisions.reason: The word means firmly set. It may describe the priests standing steady, or the firm ground under them; either way the priests held their place in the riverbed until everyone had crossed.

decisions.choice: the whole nation: Israel as one people
decisions.reason: The word often names other nations, but here it names Israel as a people entering its own land, as God promised Abraham (Genesis 12:2).

decisions.choice: They stayed there
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the priests did not move until the crossing was over.
